purpose: The ONE shared dictionary of condition words. The committee writes conditions in these words; AQE's live alert engine evaluates exactly these words. If a word is not here, neither side may use it. PM 2026-10-02: 'there is NO CHANGE to what committee looks at and lands at as recommend or advance. it is simply printing it in a format AQE alert can pick it up.'
grammar: Each condition is one string: <word>[:<arg>[:<arg>]]. A level argument is a field name from 'levels', optionally offset: <field>, <field>-0.5atr, <field>+2pct. Numbers are never written for a level -- the tool reads them from the stamped export, so the committee and AQE always see the same price.

levels.bar_high: YESTERDAY's intraday high. During today's session this is 'the prior day's high' (Seow C5, Raschke C3) -- NOT prior_bar_high
levels.high_52w_close: 52-week CLOSING high. AQE's high_52w is a closing high; the alias makes that explicit. A trade-through of it is an uptick, not a breakout
levels.base_low_20d: lowest low of the last 20 sessions
levels.fib_swing_high: the swing high the Fibs are drawn from
levels.fib_swing_low: the swing low the Fibs are drawn from

h1_close_above.meaning: a completed 1-hour candle closes above the level

h1_close_below.meaning: a completed 1-hour candle closes below the level

trade_above.meaning: trades through the level (a touch -- logged, never an ACTION on its own)

reclaim.meaning: trades below the level, then a 1-hour close back above it (spring / failed breakdown)

reject.meaning: trades above the level, then a 1-hour close back below it (upthrust / failed breakout)

in_zone.meaning: price within 0.25 ATR of the level (the wait-for area)

vol_x_ge.meaning: volume so far today vs this stock's normal volume BY THIS TIME OF DAY (20-day average of the same 15-minute slots) is at least x. 1.4 means the same at 10:30 and 15:30

vol_x_le.meaning: time-of-day volume ratio at most x (quiet / dry-up)

above_vwap_s.meaning: the last completed 1-hour candle closes above TODAY's session VWAP (built from today's 1-hour candles). Not judged until the second hour completes

below_vwap_s.meaning: n consecutive 1-hour closes below today's session VWAP

rs_today_gt_spy.meaning: the stock's % change today is above SPY's

fade_atr_ge.meaning: price has fallen at least x ATR from today's high (Livermore's one-day reaction)

clv_ge.meaning: close in the top x of the day's range (0-1)

clv_le.meaning: close in the bottom x of the day's range

elder_le.meaning: AQE elder reading at or below n at the close

elder_ge.meaning: AQE elder reading at or above n at the close

ma_above.meaning: first average above the second (e.g. ma_above:ma_20:ma_40)

age_ge.meaning: the idea is at least n sessions old without its buy condition met (time stop)

block.buy: list of words -- ALL must be true for this analyst to act
block.confirm: list of words this analyst also needs (volume, VWAP, strength)
block.wrong: list of words -- ANY one true proves this analyst wrong
block.wait: list of level fields: the area this analyst wants price to come back to (pullback lanes)
block.chase: one word: past this, too late to buy (e.g. close_above:pivot_high+5pct)
block.non_price: <=200 free text: fundamental, tape or other legs no engine can see
